ety.text: Alternative spelling of aliquid. Spellings where word-final -d is replaced with -t or vice versa are attested for a number of Latin words, e.g. quod/quot, et/ed, at/ad, haud/haut. Adams 2013 supposes that word-final /t/ and /d/ were distinguished in general, but could assimilate in voicing to a following obstruent consonant (with /d/ becoming [t] before a voiceless consonant and /t/ becoming [d] before a voiced consonant) and assumes that this led to variation between the use of the letters t and d in word-final position, regardless of what sound followed.
